about: Causal backward row_value dependencies (WINDOW-12, COLUMN-5/6/8). Authored examples prove lag-n, independent partitions, causal ordering, missing stored results, nested self reads and converted handler substitutions. Unsupported future, filtered, state-ordered and mixed-window cycles retain dependency_cycle. Expected values and failures are independently specified.

documents.independent_history:
yamaa: '1.0'
type: spec
domain: TEST
base: SRC
keys: [ID]
input:
  SRC:
    path: input.csv
    types: {ID: int, X: int}
output:
  path: out.csv
  columns: [ID, P, STATE]
windows:
  VISITS:
    order_by: [ID]
columns:
- name: ID
  type: int
  derivation: SRC.ID
- name: P
  type: int
  derivation:
    row_value:
      source: STATE
      offset: -1
      window: VISITS
- name: INDEPENDENT
  type: int
  derivation: SRC.X
- name: STATE
  type: int
  derivation:
    case:
    - when: P IS NULL
      then: INDEPENDENT
    - otherwise: P + INDEPENDENT
